        var odoo = ;

        (function () {
            var INSTANCE_ID = ;
            var POLL_MS     = 4000;
            var LINES       = 500;

            var allLines   = [];   // all fetched lines
            var query      = '';   // current search query
            var liveTimer  = null;

            var terminal    = document.getElementById('terminal');
            var svcSelect   = document.getElementById('svc-select');
            var searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
            var btnLive     = document.getElementById('btn-live');
            var statusEl    = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var lineCountEl = document.getElementById('line-count');
            var emptyMsg    = document.getElementById('empty-msg');
            var filterInfo  = document.getElementById('filter-info');

            /* ── RPC ── */
            function rpc(method, params) {
                return fetch('/web/dataset/call_kw', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(),
                        params: {
                            model: 'cloud.instance', method: 'dummy',
                            args: [], kwargs: {},
                        },
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
            }

            function fetchJson(url, body) {
                return fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(), params: body }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            /* ── Render ── */
            function render() {
                var filtered = query
                    ? allLines.filter(function (l) { return l.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1; })
                    : allLines;

                // remove old log lines (keep emptyMsg node)
                while (terminal.firstChild) terminal.removeChild(terminal.firstChild);
                terminal.appendChild(emptyMsg);

                if (filtered.length === 0) {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = '';
                    emptyMsg.textContent   = allLines.length ? 'No lines match the filter.' : 'No log output.';
                } else {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
                    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
                    filtered.forEach(function (line) {
                        var div = document.createElement('div');
                        div.className = 'log-line' + (query ? ' hl' : '');
                        div.textContent = line;
                        frag.appendChild(div);
                    });
                    terminal.appendChild(frag);
                }

                lineCountEl.textContent = (query
                    ? filtered.length + ' / ' + allLines.length
                    : allLines.length) + ' lines';

                if (query) {
                    filterInfo.style.display = '';
                    filterInfo.textContent   = 'Filtering: "' + query + '"';
                } else {
                    filterInfo.style.display = 'none';
                }

                // always scroll to bottom
                terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
            }

            /* ── Fetch logs ── */
            function fetchLogs() {
                var svc = svcSelect.value;
                if (!svc) return;
                setStatus('loading', 'Loading…');
                fetchJson('/cloud/fetch_container_logs', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                    service:     svc,
                    lines:       LINES,
                }).then(function (result) {
                    if (!result) { setStatus('error', 'No response.'); return; }
                    if (result.ok) {
                        allLines = result.lines || [];
                        render();
                        setStatus('', svc + ' — ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
                    } else {
                        setStatus('error', result.error || 'Error.');
                    }
                }).catch(function () {
                    setStatus('error', 'Connection error.');
                });
            }

            function setStatus(cls, text) {
                statusEl.className    = cls;
                statusEl.textContent  = text;
            }

            /* ── Live toggle ── */
            function startLive() {
                if (liveTimer) return;
                fetchLogs();
                liveTimer = setInterval(fetchLogs, POLL_MS);
                btnLive.textContent = '⏸ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-on';
            }

            function stopLive() {
                clearInterval(liveTimer);
                liveTimer = null;
                btnLive.textContent = '▶ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-off';
            }

            btnLive.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (liveTimer) { stopLive(); } else { startLive(); }
            });

            /* ── Service change ── */
            svcSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                allLines = [];
                render();
                fetchLogs();
            });

            /* ── Search ── */
            var searchTimer = null;
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                clearTimeout(searchTimer);
                searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                    render();
                }, 200);
            });

            /* ── Init ── */
            if (svcSelect.options.length) {
                fetchLogs();
            }
        })();
